blocks.content: Quiz: Which of these reasons can cause a promise to fail?
Tap an option below to answer:
Promises fail only when the browser tab is closed
Closing a tab stops the page, but promises don't "fail" for that reason. Promises fail when they are rejected.
Closing a tab stops the page, but promises don't "fail" for that reason. Promises fail when they are rejected.
A promise fails if you forget to use .then()
.then() just listens for success. Not using it doesn't fail the promise — it just means you didn't handle the result.
.then() just listens for success. Not using it doesn't fail the promise — it just means you didn't handle the result.
An external API returns an error
Promises often depend on things outside your control (server, network, API). If that external system returns an error, the promise can be rejected.
Promises often depend on things outside your control (server, network, API). If that external system returns an error, the promise can be rejected.
A promise fails if it takes more than 1 second
Time alone doesn't make a promise fail. A promise can take 1ms or 10 seconds, it fails only if something goes wrong and it gets rejected.
Time alone doesn't make a promise fail. A promise can take 1ms or 10 seconds, it fails only if something goes wrong and it gets rejected.
